name: Dev workflow
description: Skills and agent setups that plan, review, test and ship code for you: the loop from idea to merged pull request, run by your coding agent.

name: Research
description: Tools that send your agent out to search, read and synthesise: web and social research, deep dives, trend tracking and grounded summaries.

name: Marketing
description: Agent tooling for growth work: paid ads, SEO, content marketing, campaigns and the audits and reports that go with them.

name: Design & diagrams
description: Skills that make your agent better at visual work: interfaces, diagrams, slides and anything you need to look at rather than read.

name: Writing
description: Tools for text: editing, rewriting, tone and style, and keeping agent-written prose from sounding like every other agent.

name: Security
description: Scanners and guardrails for the agent era: vetting skills and MCP servers before you install them, and catching prompt injection, exfiltration and supply-chain risks.

name: Agent teams
description: Rosters of specialist subagents and personas you install as a set, so one harness can act as a whole team of experts.
